law_record.title: When pedestrian must yield right-of-way to vehicle (1)(e)
law_record.text: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: When authorized to cross diagonally, pedestrians shall cross only in accordance with the official traffic-control devices pertaining to such crossing movements.

activation_conditions: a diagonal crossing is authorized at the intersection
the subject is a pedestrian making it
exceptions: the white-cane rule governs instead where it applies
residue: what the devices prescribe for a diagonal crossing (an all-way phase) must be read from the device states the source reports
summary.subject: pedestrian

timing_requirements.requirement: the crossing must accord with the devices throughout, so a phase change during the crossing matters
